portfolioDecisions.brandDecision: Interbotix and Trossen Robotics remain separate profiles. The existing Trossen source profile now explicitly maps its identically named manufacturer to the sixteen newly documented Trossen-brand offerings; the manufacturer page states in-house design/machining/assembly. No profile/source identity is renamed, merged or removed.
notAdditionalCards: Glide is explicitly passive and encoder-only; Cockpit is an operator stand. TRumi is a handheld demonstration collector. Neither is an independently actuated robot.
Rivet Cockpit Bundle adds operator equipment to the same two-Pro-arm chassis; conditional camera/compute/discount options are not extra robot chassis.

Standalone named X-Series and ALOHA-related arms are separately documented offerings, not duplicate kit cards. PincherX-100 Mobile lower-profile base and drawings remain configuration findings without an additional SKU card in this review.
Third-party AgileX research UGVs, SLATE and LoCoBot leads need separate brand/configuration reconciliation; no wholesale reassignment to Trossen.
TOTL computers, control laptops, camera accessories, SDK, cloud services and GUI/tutorial workflows are not extra robot models.
unresolvedMappings: Current Core/Pro product reach 700 mm versus preliminary table 790 mm; Heavy 1400 mm versus 1114 mm.
Heavy standalone arm/table 6 kg versus Workbench Heavy package 8 kg per arm; no exact load-at-reach or generation reconciliation.
PincherX-150 named overview 150 mm reach with 900 mm total span; family axial tip length has a different metric. No corrected number invented.
ViperX-300 6DOF family gripper max 114 mm versus named joint range 116 mm; contact gap not established.
Legacy dollar pricing currency and current stock, full delivered compute packages and complete historical/regional variants remain unverified.
ALOHA Mobile raster minimum/maximum drawings downloaded but image viewing was unavailable; no numeric dimensions derived.
furtherResearch: SLATE and X-Series LoCoBot current/historical hardware, exact provider/manufacturer mapping and named configurations.
Next-generation drawings, final load/reach specifications, offers and shipment status; preliminary/coming-soon claims require follow-up.
PincherX-100 Mobile version and independently supplied ALOHA arm subvariants; no unverified variant count extrapolation.
Independent accuracy, payload-at-reach, safety/integration validation and current/historical portfolio completeness.

validation.initialValidationFindings: Initial new unit assertion used the wrong brand model-array property; corrected to robots. The existing provider regression assumed Trossen had no own products; it now checks sixteen Trossen-brand models while retaining all Interbotix family targets and prohibiting an Interbotix manufacturer mapping. Original directory snapshot date restored before final refresh/build; a stale intermediate build was stopped. Initial browser run passed 48/50: two assertions looked for description wording in a highlight section; exact published omission wording is now checked. Static verifier corrected to check the actual header website link and source URLs separately from website section fragments. Final unit/build/browser/rendered checks passed.
validation.scope: Forty usable bodies: 35 HTML plus five PDF documents with 14 text pages. One short documentation index used only for discovery. Twelve named overview tables and the preliminary three-model colspan matrix checked, plus 41 additional exact anchors. Two raster ALOHA drawings downloaded but not visually inspected because the image viewer was unavailable; no dimensions inferred. Fifty selected browser cases, not a full browser-suite rerun. Manufacturer figures are not independent certification.
